disposition_reason: The paper contains an original assessment of three pretrained neural decoders against individual reappraisal measures in Figure 5b/Extended Data Table 3, with training-cohort exclusions. This ordered predictive route must be recovered before admission. The legacy three-correlation meta-analysis and newly authored held-study CRPS are not this task; neither larger biological effects nor significance alone constitute improvement.

source_paper.title: Emotion regulation capacity lacks a shared neural signature

evidence.locator: Results and Methods: Multivariate neuro-affective signatures; Figure 5b/caption; Extended Data Table 3; Divergence of capacity indices/Table 1 for legacy calibration only
evidence.supports: Original fixed neural-signature assessment, original cohort/training-overlap exclusions, dot-product prediction and pooled standardized correlation analysis; distinct from the legacy summary meta-analysis.

target.description: Original Figure 5b prediction assessment: fixed neural-signature expression versus individual trait questionnaires and task-based affective reappraisal measures. Preserve every original decoder/target pairing.

dataset.description: Original person-level beta-contrast images, outcome measures and pretrained signature-weight images for the source four-study assessment are not authenticated. The released study-summary workbook alone cannot supply this prediction task.

cohort.description: Figure 5 names four studies totaling 730 people: AHAB-2 180, PIP 176, Doren 139 and study 4 235. Exact participant identities, per-pair missingness and signature-specific inclusion joins remain unbound.

split.description: Preserve pretrained-decoder assessment and original exclusions: negative-affect decoder excludes AHAB-2, ability decoder excludes PIP because those were their training samples. Exact training/evaluation overlap and complete model provenance require authentication; new leave-study-out folds are an extension.

inputs.description: Source signature expression uses the person reappraise-negative minus view-negative beta image dotted with a fixed signature-weight image. Exact neural input/weight identities and accessible person-level data remain unresolved; outcome measures cannot be candidate inputs.

preprocessing.description: For Figure 5b, source signature-expression scores and capacity measures are standardized within study, then pooled across people. Figure 5a condition-effect standardization is a different operation.

metric.description: Between-person Pearson correlation for each original signature/target pairing, with original sign orientation: covariance divided by the product of standard deviations. The reported near-zero bound is not an exact baseline vector.

aggregation.description: Source reports study-specific and pooled person-level correlations after within-study standardization; no newly equal-weighted held-study CRPS or composite across signatures is defined.

comparison.primary_metric: Figure 5b/Extended Data Table 3 original signature-to-capacity Pearson-correlation panel; target orientation and decision rule unresolved

published_baseline.description: Exact Extended Data Table 3 decoder/target values have not been recovered as authenticated numeric results. The textual absolute-correlation bound of 0.06 must not replace the vector or become a guessed baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No original pretrained signature weights, person-image join or full source assessment has been rerun. A meta-analysis reconstruction or new study-level predictor is not an author decoder baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify an improvement in original predictive fidelity with fixed outcome orientation, full pairing coverage and source-compatible participants. Do not maximize an arbitrary association, absolute sign flip or significance statistic.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level comparison with study clustering/heterogeneity and original training-overlap exclusions; define simultaneous decisions across the retained decoder/target panel.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant within study, with signature/outcome repeated measurements and cohort overlap explicitly resolved
uncertainty.rationale: Neither voxels nor repeated signatures are independent people. The published pooled intervals do not by themselves qualify a candidate-superiority rule.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact original Figure 5b/Extended Data Table 3 prediction panel, numerical source baseline, pretrained weights and person-level input/outcome identities.
Preserve AHAB-2/PIP training-sample exclusions and original decoder-target support; do not train or select the candidate using final evaluation outcomes.

Fix the original target orientation and source-compatible predictive metric before iteration; require a justified meaningful gain and valid uncertainty against both the published result and author rerun.
Do not count summary-meta-analysis agreement, stronger biological significance, a new held-study CRPS task or a new cohort/split as surpassing this source prediction assessment.

current_sota.description: The paper evaluates historical pretrained signatures. No matched present-day best decoder on this exact original cohort/panel has been verified.

episode.improvement_loop: Recover the original fixed-decoder assessment and a valid development-data policy before candidate iteration. Existing summary-meta-analysis and held-study CRPS work remain separate.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate weights/method, permissible training sources, outcome orientation, preprocessing and all selection decisions before original-cohort final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and authenticated original decoders on exactly the paper-specific participants and decoder/target pairs with source training-overlap exclusions. No scientific run is admitted by this file.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep Table 3 published results, original-signature reruns, summary-meta-analysis calibration and prospective held-study predictors as separate evidence objects.

blocking_issues: Exact Table 3 numeric reference panel and predictive direction/decision rule not bound.
Person-level beta images/outcomes, signature weights and original participant/exclusion joins not authenticated.
Pretrained decoder training-overlap provenance and a permissible candidate-development policy are unresolved.
No admitted author decoder rerun, same-task evaluator, meaningful-effect/uncertainty rule or fixed access/resource budgets.
Legacy summary meta-analysis still has cohort-reuse and Fisher-z/reporting-scale ambiguities; it cannot stand in for the individual prediction route.

legacy.notes: Preserve all full120, trusted-owner and reporting-control materials unchanged as calibration of the three summary meta-analyses. This source-native Figure 5b assessment is recovered from the paper, not from the newly authored CRPS extension; no existing grader is silently repurposed.
